title: "Multiplied"
date: "2026-07-20"
categories: [news]
---

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(plotly)

# Data
x_vals <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 400)
y_vals <- exp(x_vals)
df <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

# Label positions
x_points <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
y_points <- exp(x_points)
y_points[length(y_points)] <- y_points[length(y_points)-1]*0.8

# Your data
y <- c(1.000000, 2.718282, 7.389056, 20.085537, 54.598150, 43.678520)
x <- 0:5

# Fit a smooth curve (loess)
lo <- loess(y_points ~ x_points)
x_smooth <- seq(min(x_points), max(x_points), length.out = 400)
y_smooth <- predict(lo, x_smooth)

# Plotly interactive plot
plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(
    x = x_smooth,
    y = y_smooth,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(width = 4, color = "#1B4F72"),
    name = "Smooth fit"
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 10, color = "#2A6F9E"),
    name = "Data points"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Curve fit to provided values",
    xaxis = list(title = "x"),
    yaxis = list(title = "y")
  )


# Updated labels
x_desc <- c(
  "fièvre",
  "pas de fruits",
  "petit reste",
  "guerre",
  "exil",
  "repentance"
)

# Hover text boxes (can be different or richer)
hover_desc <- c(
  "Symptôme initial : fièvre",
  "Absence de fruits, ciel fermé",
  "Un petit reste subsiste",
  "Conflits, guerre",
  "Exil final",
  "Sabbat forcé"
)

# Curve segments (uniform thickness)
solid_part      <- subset(df, x <= 3)
intermittent_1  <- subset(df, x > 3 & x <= 3.5)
intermittent_2  <- subset(df, x > 3.5)

# Build plot
p <- plot_ly() %>%
  
  # Solid curve (uniform thickness)
  add_lines(
    data = solid_part,
    x = ~x, y = ~y,
    line = list(width = 2, color = "#2A6F9E"),
    name = "solid"
  ) %>%
  
  # Intermittent dashed
  add_lines(
    data = intermittent_1,
    x = ~x, y = ~y,
    line = list(width = 4, color = "#2A6F9E", dash = "dash"),
    name = "dash"
  ) %>%
  
  # Intermittent dotted
  add_lines(
    data = intermittent_2,
    x = ~x, y = ~y,
    line = list(width = 4, color = "#2A6F9E", dash = "dot"),
    name = "dot"
  )  %>%
  
# Invisible points carrying hover text
  add_markers(
    x = x_points,
    y = y_points,
    text = hover_desc,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(size = 20, opacity = 0),   # invisible
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  
# Layout with integer x ticks and y ticks at multiples of 20
  layout(
  title = "Loi des malédictions divines",
  xaxis = list(
    title = "degré de désobéissance",
    tickmode = "array",
    tickvals = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
  ),
  yaxis = list(
    title = "niveau de sanction",
    range = c(0, 70),
    tickmode = "array",
    tickvals = seq(0, 60, by = 20)
  ),
  showlegend = FALSE
)


# Add labels at (x, exp(x))
for (i in seq_along(x_points)) {
  p <- p %>% add_annotations(
    x = x_points[i],
    y = y_points[i],
    text = x_desc[i],
    showarrow = FALSE,
    align = "center",
    xanchor = "center",
    yanchor = "bottom",
    bgcolor = "white",
    bordercolor = "#2A6F9E",
    borderwidth = 2,
    borderpad = 4,
    font = list(size = 14)
  )
}

p

```
